hero.title2: One Platform, Four Ways to Work
hero.description: From personal offline coding to enterprise AI team collaboration — Yunji provides the right AI-native workspace for every kind of developer. Start free forever, data stays private, scale as you grow.

products.title: 4-Generation Product Matrix
products.subtitle: From free to enterprise, from local to cloud, from solo to AI team. Each generation solves real problems for a specific audience.

pc.name: Yunji PC
pc.tagline: Local-first AI coding tool. Your data stays on your machine.
pc.desc: Forever free, no feature gating. Works offline with Ollama. Privacy-first — code, AI chat, and knowledge stay 100% local.

detail.heading: Yunji PC — Local-First AI Coding
detail.intro: Yunji PC is a forever-free local AI coding desktop tool. Double-click to launch, works offline, Ollama integrated. PyQt6 native window — faster and lighter than web-based alternatives.

features.title: Offline Ready
features.desc: Works without internet. Ollama local models at zero cost.

features.title: Privacy First
features.desc: Code, AI chat, and knowledge stay 100% on your machine. Zero telemetry.

features.title: Zero Registration
features.desc: Double-click the EXE and start. No account needed.

web.name: Yunji Web
web.desc: Seamless switching across desktop, phone, and tablet. Cloud AI one-click access, local Ollama mode also available. PWA and mobile coverage.

detail.heading: Yunji Web — Cross-Platform Lightweight Workspace
detail.intro: Yunji Web delivers cross-platform AI coding. One account, seamless switching across desktop, phone, and tablet. FastAPI backend + Vue 3 frontend with PWA/Capacitor multi-device coverage.

features.title: Multi-Device Sync
features.desc: Start on desktop, continue on phone. 3 devices simultaneously.

features.title: Cloud AI
features.desc: One-click cloud model access. No Ollama setup needed.

features.title: Local Mode
features.desc: Prefer data on-device? Switch to Ollama mode anytime.

features.title: PWA Support
features.desc: Your phone becomes the app. No app store install needed.

team.name: Yunji Team
team.tagline: Full-featured AI coding workspace for teams.
team.desc: 5-role team collaboration, 4-layer knowledge engine, Yjs real-time collaboration. SSO + audit + multi-tenant — enterprise compliance ready.

detail.heading: Yunji Team — Full AI Coding Team Workspace
detail.intro: Yunji Team provides complete AI coding team collaboration. 5-role team model (Lead/Architect/Dev/QA/Docs), 4-layer knowledge engine (Correction/Pattern/Fact/Preference) with strength evolution, and Yjs CRDT real-time collaboration.

features.title: 5-Role Team
features.desc: Lead, Architect, Dev, QA, Docs — boundary checks and cross-review built in.

features.title: 4-Layer Knowledge Engine
features.desc: Correction, Pattern, Fact, Preference + strength evolution. Gets smarter over time.

features.title: Yjs Real-Time Collab
features.desc: Multiple users editing files simultaneously. CRDT guarantees no data loss.

features.title: Enterprise Compliance
features.desc: SSO + audit logs + multi-tenant + private deployment options.

agentwork.name: AgentWork
agentwork.tagline: AI agent workstation. AI employees + AI teams + industry templates.
agentwork.desc: Next-gen AI R&D workspace. Multi-Agent DAG true parallelism, AST-Native code cognition, compile-time verification guardrails.

pricing.title: Transparent Pricing
pricing.subtitle: Flat monthly pricing, no per-seat charges. From free to enterprise — every tier honestly defined through deep user research.

account.title: One Account, All Products
account.subtitle: Sign up once, access Yunji PC, Web, Team, and AgentWork. Unified identity, seamless cross-platform.

download.title: Download & Access
download.subtitle: Choose your product and get started. All products accessible from a single entry point.

footer.tagline: Yunji is an AI-native workspace company. Four generations of products covering individual to enterprise scenarios.
